items.name: dsh-chatvoice
items.desc: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.

items.name: dsh-speak
items.desc: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.

items.name: dsh-plugin-uisfx
items.desc: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify
items.desc: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.

items.name: dsh-voice-input-plugin
items.desc: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.

items.name: dsh-voice-call
items.desc: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.

items.name: dsh-voice-webspeech
items.desc: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).

items.name: dsh-plugin-notify-sound
items.desc: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.

items.name: dsh-plugin-tts
items.desc: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.

items.name: dsh-ding
items.desc: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).

items.name: dsh-plugin-call-me
items.desc: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.

items.name: dsh-perlica-ding
items.desc: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.

items.name: dsh-mic-input
items.desc: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.

items.name: dsh-voice-input
items.desc: Mic button in the composer tool row: Web Speech API speech-to-text (Chrome/Edge), language switching, and optional auto-send, zero dependencies.

items.name: voco-input-sh
items.desc: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).

items.name: dsh-sound
items.desc: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).

items.name: dsh-stt-input
items.desc: Speech-to-text voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer transcribes speech into the draft via the browser Web Speech API (zero-config) or an OpenAI-compatible Whisper API (OpenAI / Groq), with a selectable model and language in Settings.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.

items.name: dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin
items.desc: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.

items.name: dsh-dingo
items.desc: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.

items.name: dsh-fish-tts
items.desc: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.

items.name: dsh-voice-input
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.

items.name: dsh-voice-live
items.desc: Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.

items.name: dsh-mimotts
items.desc: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.

items.name: dsh-tts-flash
items.desc: Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.

items.name: dsh-livevoice
items.desc: Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.

items.name: dsh-localtts
items.desc: Connects existing IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS installations for sentence-level assistant reading in Harness web, with local process launch and playback controls.

items.name: dsh-dictation-hotkey
items.desc: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.

items.name: dsh-soundscape
items.desc: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.

items.name: dsh-voice-call
items.desc: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.

items.name: dsh-read-aloud
items.desc: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel.

items.name: dsh-ears-prosody
items.desc: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.

items.name: dsh-voice-talk
items.desc: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.

items.name: dsh-say
items.desc: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.

items.name: dsh-funasr-voice
items.desc: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.

items.name: dsh-voice-announcer
items.desc: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.

items.name: dsh-voice-doubao
items.desc: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.

items.name: dsh-tts
items.desc: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.

items.name: dsh-voice
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

items.name: dsh-plugin-mynah
items.desc: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.

items.name: dsh-asr-plugin
items.desc: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.

items.name: dsh-ximalaya
items.desc: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.

items.name: dsh-hold-to-dictate
items.desc: Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.

items.name: dsh-live-voice
items.desc: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.

items.name: dsh-music-studio
items.desc: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.

items.name: dsh-meeting-room
items.desc: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).

items.name: dsh-pianist
items.desc: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.

items.name: dsh-mimo-tts
items.desc: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.

items.name: dsh-voco
items.desc: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.

items.name: dsh-voice-alert
items.desc: Speaks or plays a sound at the end of every turn and plays a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors. Ships 20 built-in effects (10 alert chimes + 10 nature sounds) and defaults to effect mode, so it needs no API key and no audio files; an optional Volcengine voice-clone route generates the three announcement clips in one click. Plays through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-voice-chat
items.desc: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.

items.name: dsh-typewriter-blip
items.desc: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.

items.name: dsh-xiaoai-bridge
items.desc: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.

items.name: dsh-voice-scribe
items.desc: Voice input for the web UI: tap Alt (or Alt+Space) to start/stop dictation, browser Web Speech (zero-config) or OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR, optional polish through DSH-configured LLM, settings UI.

items.name: dsh-talk
items.desc: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.

items.name: dsh-omi-voice
items.desc: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.

items.name: dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
items.desc: Adds Xiaomi MiMo text-to-speech to DSH Web with assistant-message read-aloud, PCM streaming, preset and custom voice design, browser speech fallback, playback controls, and optional UI sounds.

items.name: dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode
items.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.

items.name: dsh-voice-input-cn
items.desc: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.

items.name: dsh-audiogen
items.desc: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.

items.name: dsh-voice-control
items.desc: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.

items.name: dsh-voice-assistant
items.desc: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.

items.name: dsh-gsv
items.desc: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.

items.name: dsh-xiaozhi
items.desc: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.

items.name: dsh-volume-knob
items.desc: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.

items.name: dsh-hold-to-talk
items.desc: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).

items.name: dsh-voice-agent#voice-app
items.desc: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.

items.name: dsh-ears
items.desc: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-ding-sound
items.desc: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.

items.name: dsh-multi-tts
items.desc: Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.

items.name: dsh-dania-voice
items.desc: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.

items.name: dsh-tool-lipsync
items.desc: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.

items.name: dsh-duet
items.desc: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.

items.name: dsh-tts-bridge
items.desc: Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.

items.name: dsh-watch-video
items.desc: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.

items.name: creating#plugin
items.desc: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.
